sections.section_title: FDCAN Tx buffer cancellation finished interrupt enable register (FDCAN_TXBCIE)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.43 "FDCAN Tx buffer cancellation finished interrupt enable register (FDCAN_TXBCIE)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3715.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00E4
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 CFIE[31:0]: Cancellation finished interrupt enable
Each Tx buffer has its own cancellation finished interrupt enable bit.
0: Cancellation finished interrupt disabled
1: Cancellation finished interrupt enabled
